name: Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny knoll in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl provides ideal conditions for a relaxing nature holiday, featuring timber accents and panoramic vistas.

Lake Thiersee and scenic hiking routes up Mount Pendling are reachable within minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl in Thiersee offers relaxing days in a peaceful setting in Kufsteinerland.
